description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ultimecia (Wind)], [Apex Hell's Judgment Damage Tracker] and [Apex Hell's Judgment Level]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ultimecia (Wind)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Hell's Judgment (0~2), removed after using Apex Hell's Judgment two times

description.name: Apex Hell's Judgment Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Hell's Judgment level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ultimecia (Wind)]

description.name: Apex Hell's Judgment Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Hell's Judgment level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ultimecia (Wind)]
